title: Management Fee and Escalation Tariff for the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Workplace Cafe Management Program — Management Fee and Escalation Tariff

The tariff fixes, for each service model, the standard monthly management fee, the commercial basis the fee is written on, the administration fee charged on invoiced food cost, the contractual annual escalation applied to the management fee, the calendar days of notice given before menu prices rise, and the portfolio fee discount ladder mapping the number of cafe contracts a client holds to the management fee discount percentage.

| Service model | Monthly management fee (USD) | Commercial basis | Administration fee on food cost (per cent) | Annual escalation (per cent) | Price increase notice (calendar days) | Portfolio fee discount ladder |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 1850.00 USD | profit and loss | 0 per cent | 3.25 per cent | 45 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 1 per cent; 6 contracts: 2 per cent; 12 contracts: 3 per cent |
| Limited Service Cafe | 4275.00 USD | profit and loss | 0 per cent | 3.5 per cent | 60 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 1.25 per cent; 6 contracts: 2.25 per cent; 12 contracts: 3.5 per cent |
| Full Service Cafe | 9850.00 USD | fixed fee | 4.5 per cent | 3.75 per cent | 90 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 1.5 per cent; 6 contracts: 2.75 per cent; 12 contracts: 4 per cent |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 17400.00 USD | cost plus | 6.25 per cent | 4 per cent | 90 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 1.75 per cent; 6 contracts: 3.25 per cent; 12 contracts: 4.75 per cent |
| Executive Dining Service | 21650.00 USD | cost plus | 6.75 per cent | 4.25 per cent | 90 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 2 per cent; 6 contracts: 3.5 per cent; 12 contracts: 5 per cent |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 38900.00 USD | cost plus | 7.5 per cent | 3.9 per cent | 120 calendar days | 1 contract: 0 per cent; 3 contracts: 2.25 per cent; 6 contracts: 4 per cent; 12 contracts: 5.75 per cent |

The commercial basis moves from profit and loss under the two lightest-touch models to fixed fee under Full Service Cafe and to cost plus under the three richest models; the administration fee on food cost is nil where no such fee is printed against the service model and rises with tier where a fixed fee or cost plus basis is written. The portfolio fee discount ladder widens at every rung as the service model tier rises, and every service model carries a nil discount at a single held contract.

Consider a hypothetical client holding the cafe management contract for one site under the Full Service Cafe model. The monthly management fee printed against that model is 9850.00 USD, written on a fixed fee basis, carrying an administration fee of 4.5 per cent of invoiced food cost, an annual escalation of 3.75 per cent, and 90 calendar days of notice before menu prices rise. Were that same hypothetical client to hold twelve cafe contracts across its portfolio, the management fee discount read from the ladder against twelve contracts under the Full Service Cafe model would be 4 per cent.
